name: City Council Special Meeting Agenda - Vacancy Education Bus Tour (PDF)
agenda_text:
CITY  OF  ALHAMBRA

  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY COUNCIL
  (Notice No. N2M23-38)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City of Alhambra and the Alhambra Chamber of
Commerce will be hosting a Vacancy Education Bus Tour on Thursday, April 6, 2023,
commencing at 10:00 a.m., at Alhambra City Hall located at 111 South First Street,
Alhambra, California and continuing to the following locations at the times listed – please note
all times are approximations:

  Time  Location  Address
  10:00 am  1. Alhambra City Hall  111 S. First Street
  10:08 am  2. Rioni Building  247 E. Main Street
  10:38 am  3. Valley Court Building  2 E. Valley Boulevard
  11:08 am  4. Cakelly Plaza  555 W. Main Street
  11:31 am  5. Plaza on Main  369 W. Main Street
  12:00 noon  6. Alhambra City Hall  111 S. First Street

It is intended that this Vacancy Education Bus Tour will be led by the Alhambra Chamber of
Commerce. However, due to the possibility that three (3) or more members of the Alhambra City
Council may attend this meeting, which will include a discussion of the current/potential uses of
the aforementioned vacant properties, notice of a special meeting of the Alhambra City Council
is hereby given pursuant to the order of the Mayor of the City of Alhambra, the Alhambra City
Charter, the Alhambra Municipal Code and Section 54956 of the Government Code of the State
of California. It is anticipated that there will be limited space on the bus for the public to
accompany the City Council or alternatively members of the public may caravan or meet at the
above locations at the above approximated times.

  LAUREN MYLES, CMC
  CITY CLERK

Dated:  April 4, 2023
Notice No.  N2M23-38
File No.  F2M21-43
